paper_title: Machine learning center-specific models show improved IVF live birth predictions over US national registry-based model
prediction_task: IVF live birth prediction using center-specific ML vs national SART model

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Make new figure with real calibration plots for both models using 4-5 bins per clinic and overall. Include data distribution (TRIPOD example). Showing calibration plots is necessary to claim TRIPOD-AI adherence.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added bin-based calibration plots with data distribution for all clinics.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Reported AUC improvements over age-only control seem very high (41%). Does age-only control have AUC <0.5? Results should be reported per clinic with 95% CI and paired DeLong test.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added per-clinic AUC with CI and DeLong tests. Clarified age-only baseline.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Use TRIPOD+AI terminology ('internal validation data' not 'de novo model validation test set'). Missing descriptive table with differences between clinics. Need limitations section.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Adopted TRIPOD+AI terminology and added clinic comparison table and limitations.

reviewer_concerns.concern_text: Discussion gets too commercial ('Like many innovative products...', 'MLCS-based counseling reports...'). The commercial side should be toned down.
Only aggregated data presented without individual center data. Either provide per-center data including number of patients, or change manuscript scope.
reviewer_concerns.author_response: Added per-center performance tables and patient counts.

reviewer_strengths.text: Topic is very relevant — few studies compare in-house models vs general models. Paper is well-structured and well-written.
